# Foryn: Full Architectural & LLM Context Specification
Document Version: 2.4.0
Last Updated: 2026-09-04
Platform: Foryn Cloud Interior Design & Architecture Studio

================================================================================
1. SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE & PHILOSOPHY
================================================================================
Foryn is built as a single-page reactive application powered by React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion (Framer Motion engine), and D3.js. It features a complete end-to-end lifecycle for architectural firms, interior designers, modular fit-out contractors, and turn-key home builders.

Key Structural Foundations:
1. Client-Side High Performance Graphics:
   - 2D Canvas CAD engine with snap-to-grid (100mm increments), real-time rotation, dimension calculations, and multi-layer CAD controls.
   - Interactive 3D Raytracing Viewport with WebGL shaders, PBR material preview (Roughness, Metallic, IOR, Bump maps), and IES photometric lighting rigs.
2. Cross-Role Enterprise Workstations:
   - Role-based routing supporting instantaneous persona switching:
     * Sales Lead: Meta/IG lead ingestion, call log recording, 4-digit PID generator, won-deal promotion.
     * Designer Team / Architect: Floorplan authoring, layer manager, material palette, BOQ price tally.
     * Project Management: BOQ milestones, contractor payouts, inspection certificates, site progress.
     * Finance Team: GST 18% calculation, automated payout queue, RTGS batch settlement.
3. Universal Data Pipeline:
   - Lead Captured -> PID Generated -> Promoted to Project -> Vendor BOQ Assigned -> PM Milestone Approved -> Finance Payout Generated -> RTGS Disbursed -> Transactional Email Logged.

================================================================================
2. CORE TYPES & INTERFACES (TypeScript Definition Schema)
================================================================================

```typescript
export type UserRole =
  | 'Sales Lead'
  | 'Designer Team'
  | 'Project Management'
  | 'Finance Team'
  | 'Interior Designer'
  | 'Architect'
  | '3D Artist'
  | 'Homeowner';

export interface LeadItem {
  id: string; // e.g. LD-910
  pid: string; // Unique 4-digit numeric Project ID (e.g. 1001, 1002)
  clientName: string;
  phone: string;
  email: string;
  source: 'Meta / IG Ads' | 'Website Inquiry' | 'Builder Referral' | 'Walk-in Studio' | 'Architect Connect';
  estimatedBudget: number; // in INR Lakhs (e.g. 25.0)
  budgetLabel?: string;
  propertyType: string; // 2BHK, 3BHK, Villa, Commercial Studio
  location: string;
  status:
    | 'New Enquiry'
    | 'Call Scheduled'
    | 'Call Done'
    | 'Call Back Required'
    | 'No Answer'
    | 'Fake Lead'
    | 'Duplicate lead'
    | 'No Requirement'
    | 'Promoted to Sales Team';
  probability: number; // 0 - 100
  notes: string;
  assignedSalesOwner: string;
  assignedDesignLead: string;
  createdAt: string;
  lastUpdateDate: string;
  callLogs?: CallLogItem[];
  followUps?: FollowUpItem[];
  activityLogs?: ActivityLogItem[];
}

export interface VendorAssignment {
  id: string;
  projectId: string;
  projectName: string;
  category:
    | 'Modular Cabinetry Factory'
    | 'Civil & Tiling'
    | 'Electrical & Lighting'
    | 'False Ceiling & Paint'
    | 'Decor & Soft Furnishing';
  vendorName: string;
  contactPhone: string;
  totalContractValue: number; // In Lakhs
  paidToDate: number;
  pendingApprovalAmount: number;
  status: 'Contract Signed' | 'In Progress' | 'Payment Pending PM' | 'Approved by PM' | 'Cleared by Finance';
  milestones: MilestonePayment[];
}

export interface MilestonePayment {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  amount: number; // In Lakhs
  percentage: number;
  status: 'Pending' | 'PM Approved' | 'Released by Finance';
  dueDate: string;
  proofUrl?: string;
}

export interface FinanceTransaction {
  id: string;
  projectId: string;
  projectName: string;
  type: 'Client Receipt' | 'Vendor Payout' | 'GST Tax Ledger';
  partyName: string;
  category: string;
  amount: number; // In Rupees
  gstAmount: number; // 18% GST in Rupees
  netAmount: number; // Total amount including GST
  status: 'Pending PM Audit' | 'Ready for Release' | 'Completed & Paid';
  paymentRefNumber?: string;
  date: string;
  approvedByPM: boolean;
}

export interface CadLayer {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  color: string;
  visible: boolean;
  locked: boolean;
  frozen: boolean;
  lineWeight: string;
  lineType: string;
  isCurrent: boolean;
  itemCount: number;
}
```

================================================================================
3. API & TRANSACTIONAL EVENT FLOWS
================================================================================

1. Lead Ingestion & Qualification:
   - Incoming payload triggers `generateUniquePID(leads)` ensuring non-colliding sequential 4-digit identifiers.
   - Activity log appends `[FL] Lead Created`.
   - Dispatch event logs instant welcome email to client.

2. Lead Promotion to Active Project:
   - Status transitions to `Promoted to Sales Team`.
   - Auto-creates `VendorAssignment` with default modular milestone structure.
   - Notifies PM & Design teams via unified in-app toast & state pipeline.

3. Milestone Approval & Payment Disbursement:
   - PM audits milestone completion on site.
   - Triggers `handleApproveVendorPayment` -> creates `FinanceTransaction` with 18% GST breakdown.
   - Transactional email fired to `vendor.finance@foryn-suppliers.in`.
   - Finance audits and clicks `Release Payout` -> generates RTGS transaction code (e.g. `HDFC-RTGS-XXXXXX`) and updates vendor ledger balance to cleared.

================================================================================
4. KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS & INTERACTION GUIDE
================================================================================
- `Delete` / `Backspace`: Remove selected 2D CAD furniture or wall element.
- `R`: Rotate selected element by 45 degrees.
- `Cmd/Ctrl + C`: Duplicate selected plan item.
- `Space + Drag`: Pan 2D viewport.
- `Scroll Wheel`: Zoom in/out with 10% step increments.
- `T`: Open Theme Customizer & Switcher.
- `L`: Open AutoCAD Layer Manager.
- `M`: Open Shader & PBR Material Studio.
